title: Considerations for Setting Aside Green Space in Urban Development
what_it_is: Considerations for Setting Aside Green Space in Urban Development

sections.label: Questions on green space development
sections.summary: Questions asked the Minister for National Development about criteria, assessments and consultations for developing green spaces like Clementi and Dover Forest.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng
sentences.text: asked the Minister for National Development regarding Clementi Forest and similar green spaces (a) what are the criteria by which land parcels are scheduled for development; (b) how are implications for wildlife, biodiversity and green corridor connectivity assessed when a green space is developed rather than redeveloping an existing urban space; and (c) whether and how any potential irreversibility of environmental impact is considered during the above processes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
sentences.text: asked the Minister for National Development (a) whether the Ministry will consider extending the public consultation period for the Environment Baseline Study for the Dover Forest; (b) whether the results and outcome of the consultation can be made public; and (c) whether an environment impact assessment will be conducted if active development of the Dover Forest zone is considered.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
sentences.text: asked the Minister for National Development (a) what is the current number of hectares of existing green spaces that are projected to be developed over the next 10 to 15 years; (b) what percentage of these are forested areas; and (c) of the projected increase of 1,000 hectares of green spaces over the same time period, how much of the increase is reserved for wildlife compared to areas accessible to the general public.

sentences.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru
sentences.text: asked the Minister for National Development (a) what processes are in place to ensure that that public bodies respect the principles laid out in the 2015 Nature Conservation Masterplan when making any development decisions that affect our green spaces or biodiversity; (b) in relation to the Dover Forest, what was the nature and frequency of consultation that the Ministry conducted with MND, HDB and URA about the development of the forest; and (c) what steps are being proposed to address the loss of biodiversity and habitat of endangered and rare species caused by the envisaged deforestation of Dover Forest.

sections.label: BTO application rate 2020
sections.summary: In 2020, the overall application rate for BTO flats was 5.8 times.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In 2020, the overall application rate for BTO flats was 5.8 times.

sections.label: Citizen marriages and HDB flats built
sections.summary: Between 2015 and 2019, citizen marriages averaged 23,600 yearly, while an average of 16,200 new HDB flats were built each year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Between 2015 and 2019, the annual average number of Singapore citizen marriages registered was 23,600, higher than the annual average of 22,400 registered between 2010 and 2014.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: For comparison, we built an average of 16,200 new HDB flats each year over the same period to cater to BTO demand by all buyer groups and not just newlyweds.

sections.label: Average HDB household size
sections.summary: The average household size in HDB dwellings was 3.07 in 2019, compared to 4.24 in 1990.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The average household size in HDB dwellings was 3.07 in 2019, compared to 4.24 in 1990.

sections.label: Golf course land redevelopment by 2030
sections.summary: By 2030, more than 400 hectares of golf course land would have been taken back for redevelopment.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: By 2030, we would have taken back more than 400 hectares of golf course land for redevelopment.

sections.label: Redevelopment after air base and port moves
sections.summary: Height restrictions in eastern and north-eastern Singapore will be lifted after the Paya Lebar air base moves, and the Greater Southern Waterfront will be redeveloped after the port moves to Tuas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: For example, the height restrictions over a large part of eastern and north-eastern Singapore will be lifted after the air base moves out of Paya Lebar, allowing us to intensify land use both in and around the site.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We will also progressively redevelop the Greater Southern Waterfront after the port moves to Tuas, freeing up prime waterfront land for public and private housing and other purposes.

sections.label: Land safeguarded for green spaces
sections.summary: About 7,800 hectares of land are safeguarded for Nature Reserves, Nature Areas, Nature Parks and other green spaces.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Today, we have safeguarded approximately 7,800 hectares of our land for Nature Reserves, Nature Areas, Nature Parks and other green spaces, such as parks and park connectors.

sections.label: Extending green spaces and species recovery
sections.summary: Existing green spaces will be protected and enhanced, 1,000 more hectares added over 10 to 15 years, and species recovery plans implemented for 130 species by 2030.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: But over time, they have become green spaces inhabited by indigenous flora and fauna.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We will not only protect and enhance existing green spaces but will also extend our network with an additional 1,000 hectares of green spaces over the next 10 to 15 years and weave greenery more intensively into our urban areas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In tandem, we will implement species recovery plans for 130 animal and plant species by 2030 – native, flora and fauna – to strengthen the conservation of our endangered and rare species.

sections.label: Site zoning retained, no housing
sections.summary: There is no immediate need to develop the site for housing, so its zoning will be retained and it will not be touched for housing.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: While there is no immediate need to develop the site for housing, we will retain the zoning of the site for now, and not touch it for housing.

sections.label: Environmental Baseline Survey for Ulu Pandan
sections.summary: HDB engaged an external consultant to conduct an Environmental Baseline Survey for Ulu Pandan to guide development plans and identify native flora, fauna and habitats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: HDB engaged an external consultant to conduct an Environmental Baseline Survey (EBS) for Ulu Pandan, to guide HDB's development plans and identify the native flora and fauna and their habitats.

sections.label: Public consultation period extended
sections.summary: HDB will extend the public consultation period for the EBS by another four weeks and consider all feedback before sharing plans.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Accordingly, HDB will extend the public consultation period for the EBS for another four weeks.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We will carefully consider all the feedback received and share our plans when ready.

sections.label: URA engagement on long-term plans
sections.summary: URA will engage Singaporeans later this year to gather ideas, inputs and partnerships for long-term plans for a liveable and sustainable future.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: URA will engage Singaporeans later this year – as we do regularly every few years – to discuss our aspirations as a people and gather ideas and inputs, and importantly, partnerships to formulate our long-term plans for a liveable and sustainable future.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Our goal is to steward a home and a City in Nature that all Singaporeans, in this generation and future ones, love and cherish.

sections.label: Planning horizons for sites
sections.summary: Planning parameters and horizons vary by site, with big strategic sites like Greater Southern Waterfront and Paya Lebar taking decades.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: For instance, the planning parameters and planning horizons for different sites will take time.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: And for smaller sites, maybe slightly shorter; for big strategic sites like the Greater Southern Waterfront, it could take decades.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Or for Paya Lebar to relocate after land reclamation, land preparation, it will take decades.

sections.label: Plans and contingencies
sections.summary: Plans must be ready, and changes may require activating contingencies that may be the next best solution.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: And therefore, we have to make all these plans ready.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: And if there are some changes to our plans, we will then have to activate some of these contingencies, some of which may not necessarily be the best solution; it may be the next best.

sections.label: Green Corridor commitment
sections.summary: The 24 km Green Corridor runs north to south along the former Malaysia to Singapore rail to Tanjong Pagar and is committed to be kept.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Specifically, to the Green Corridor, it is 24 km thereabouts, from north to south that runs through what is formerly that rail from Malaysia to Singapore, to Tanjong Pagar.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We have committed to keep that as a green corridor.

sections.label: Ecological biodiversity and connectivity
sections.summary: Some green areas lack native flora and fauna, requiring replanting, reforesting, and removing invasive species to support biodiversity.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: It is also for ecological biodiversity and connectivity.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: There are a number of areas which look green, but if you go with Nature Society and my NParks colleagues, the survey will show that those are mainly not native flora and fauna; and a lot of effort has to go into replanting, into reforesting, into removing the invasive species and replanting them with species that can support biodiversity in the area.

sections.label: Assessments beyond environmental impact
sections.summary: Beyond environmental impact assessments, other issues affecting residents such as traffic and noise assessments are also studied.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: That is why over the last year plus, there were all these to-ing and fro-ing with our nature friends over, say, the ability of some sites in Tengah to be able to provide that level of connectivity; and we make adjustments along the way to provide for them.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: But, of course, beyond environmental impact assessments, I can assure the Members in this House that we also study other issues that also affect the residents, like traffic impact assessments, noise assessments.
